item.title: Abandoned car for 2 months, 14th August
item.description:
Hi, I would like to report a black Audi that has remained parked in exactly the same position on Alexander Road, outside number 15, for over two months. The vehicle does not appear to have been moved or used during this period and is becoming increasingly dirty, with dirt and spider webs accumulating around the vehicle. I appreciate that simply leaving a vehicle parked on a public road is not necessarily illegal. However, as a resident of the street, I am concerned by how long the vehicle has remained completely stationary and apparently unused. Parking on the road is limited, so having a vehicle left permanently in one space also reduces the available parking for other residents. Given the length of time it has remained unmoved and its deteriorating appearance, I would appreciate it if the Council could inspect the vehicle and determine whether it meets the criteria for an abandoned vehicle or whether any action is appropriate. Thank you.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Alexander Road, West Heath, Greater London

item.title: On going vehicle repairs and sales in slade green road and surrounding, 14th August
item.description:
I would like to report a further incident today relating to the ongoing vehicle repair activity associated with an individual residing at 71 Slade Green Road. Today, a red Range Rover, registration SS16 OVW, was dropped off at this location and has subsequently been left on the public road. Based on the continuing pattern of activity at this address, I have reason to believe that the vehicle has been brought here for repair work to be carried out by the individual. I have also checked the vehicle’s status and it appears to be currently untaxed, despite being left on a public road. I would ask the Council to verify this as part of its investigation. This is particularly concerning because this individual has already been reported on multiple occasions for carrying out vehicle repairs and apparent vehicle trading/sales activities from the roadside and residential area. Despite previous Council warnings, the same activity continues. The individual is understood to be renting a room at 71 Slade Green Road and appears to be repeatedly using the surrounding public highway as an extension of his vehicle repair activities.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): North End, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
